sections.title: MID-MO VALLEY/MID TO UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: WEST SOUTHWEST FLOW WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY ACROSS THE NCNTRL U.S. AS A SUBTLE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVES QUICKLY ESEWD ACROSS THE MID-MO VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON AND INTO THE MID TO UPPER MS VALLEY THIS EVENING. A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS IS FORECAST ACROSS MUCH OF THE CNTRL PLAINS EXTENDING EWD INTO THE MID-MS VALLEY WITH A STRONG GRADIENT OF INSTABILITY LOCATED FROM NERN NEB ESEWD ACROSS CNTRL IA INTO WRN IL. THIS SHOULD BE THE FAVORED MCS TRACK THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. MODEL FORECASTS ARE IN VERY GOOD AGREEMENT WITH THUNDERSTORMS INITIATING IN WRN SD THIS MORNING WITH A FAST MOVING MCS ORGANIZING ACROSS THE MID-MO VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. THIS MCS SHOULD ENCOUNTER VERY STRONG INSTABILITY IN WRN AND CNTRL IA ENABLING THE MCS TO REMAIN INTACT FOR AN EXTENDED PERIOD THROUGH MUCH OF THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW A BROAD CORRIDOR OF STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES FROM ERN NEB EWD ACROSS IA IN THE 4000 TO 5000 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...0-6 KM SHEAR VALUES IN ERN NEB AND IA ARE FORECAST TO BE IN THE 50 TO 60 KT RANGE AS A MID-LEVEL JET ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVES ACROSS THE REGION. THIS COMBINED WITH VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND STRON

sections.title: BLACK HILLS/NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL BE LOCATED IN THE NRN ROCKIES TODAY AS THE ENTRANCE REGION OF AN EXITING MID-LEVEL JET MOVES ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. BENEATH THE JET...A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS IS FORECAST ACROSS SE MT...NE WY AND THE WRN DAKOTAS BY AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD INITIATE THIS AFTERNOON ON THE WRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS ERN MT WITH CONVECTION MOVING ESEWD INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS BY EARLY EVENING. THE EXIT REGION OF THE MID-LEVEL JET SHOULD HELP ENHANCE LIFT AND ALSO WILL CREATE STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS SHOW 0-6 KM SHEAR VALUES IN THE 50 TO 60 KT RANGE WITH 700 TO 500 MB LAPSE RATES OF 7.5 TO 8.0 C/KM. THIS SHOULD BE A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR LARGE HAIL. WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY IF A PERSISTENT CLUSTER OF STORMS CAN DEVELOP DURING THE EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: HUDSON/DELAWARE RIVER VALLEYS/SRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS TODAY. BENEATH THE TROUGH...A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS SHOULD BE IN PLACE ACROSS MOST OF THE REGION BY MID-AFTERNOON WITH SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS INITIATING IN THE HIGHER TERRAIN. THIS CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO MOVE EWD INTO THE HUDSON AND DELAWARE RIVER VALLEYS REACHING SRN NEW ENGLAND BY EARLY EVENING. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ERN PA AND SERN NY SHOW 30 TO 35 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR WITH ABOUT 20 KT OF FLOW AT 850 MB. AS LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN DURING THE AFTERNOON...THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: CNTRL AND SERN AZ/SW NM
sections.text: MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL AGAIN DEVELOP TODAY ACROSS CNTRL AND SE AZ WITH THUNDERSTORMS INITIATING ALONG THE MOGOLLON RIM AND IN THE MTNS OF SERN AZ AND SW NM. FORECAST SOUNDINGS ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS SHOW VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S F. THIS SHOULD BE ENOUGH FOR SEVERE DOWNBURSTS WITH THE STRONGER CELLS LATE THIS AFTERNOON. ..BROYLES/STOPPKOTTE.. 07/19/2010

sections.title: ERN NEB/CENTRAL AND SRN IA/NRN MO/WRN IL THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: COMPLICATED SCENARIO UNFOLDING THIS MORNING REGARDING THE INFLUENCE OF ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS ON CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. OUTFLOW GENERATED BY THE ONGOING STORMS APPEARS TO BE REINFORCING THE EFFECTIVE FRONT NEAR I-80 ACROSS SE NEB AND SW IA...AND THE UPSTREAM STORMS IN SRN SD/NRN NEB ARE ROOTED ABOVE THE FRONT/OUTFLOW. THE BAND OF STORMS ACROSS IA SHOULD PERSIST UNTIL AT LEAST MID-LATE MORNING...WHICH MAY BE LONG ENOUGH TO SOMEWHAT DISRUPT PHASING OF THE UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR AND THE ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE MID-UPPER SPEED MAX WITH THE SD CONVECTION. THE LATEST OPERATIONAL NAM/GFS FORECASTS...WHILE CONSISTENT WITH ONE ANOTHER...DO NOT REFLECT THE ONGOING CONVECTION AND ITS LIKELY IMPACTS ON THE REMAINDER OF THE DAY. A LOOSE BLEND OF THE 00Z 4 KM NMM/ARW AND SOME ASPECTS OF RECENT RAPID REFRESH FORECASTS SUGGESTS THAT THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT WILL BE WITH NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE OUTFLOW-REINFORCED FRONT ACROSS SRN IA/SE NEB/NRN MO. HERE...MLCAPE OF 3000-4000 J/KG WILL COINCIDE WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT ON THE SRN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER MID-UPPER WLY FLOW. THE SUPERCELLS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL AND A

sections.title: SE MT TO WRN SD/NRN NEB THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER ID WILL MOVE EWD TO NRN WY/SE MT BY THIS EVENING...AND CONTINUE ESEWD OVER SD TONIGHT. BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS REMAIN IN THE MID 50S ACROSS WRN SD/SE MT IN THE WAKE OF OVERNIGHT CONVECTION...AND CLOUD BREAKS WILL ALLOW STRONG SURFACE HEATING FROM NRN WY INTO SE MT. EXPECT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT TO OCCUR OVER AND JUST E OF THE HIGH TERRAIN IN S CENTRAL MT...IN THE BELT OF ASCENT PRECEDING THE MIDLEVEL WAVE. THIS CONVECTION WILL THEN SPREAD ESEWD ACROSS SE MT/NE WY DURING THE EVENING...AND POTENTIALLY PERSIST AS AN MCS ACROSS WRN SD AND NRN NEB THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. WEAK-MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IN EXCESS OF 60 KT WILL SUPPORT STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT.

sections.title: NRN MID ATLANTIC TO SRN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING/DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED FROM THE MID ATLANTIC NEWD INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND IN THE WAKE OF MORNING STORMS ASSOCIATED WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA AND A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH. BY EARLY AFTERNOON...MLCAPE WILL INCREASE TO ROUGHLY 1000-1500 J/KG IN ADVANCE OF A WEAK COLD FRONT...IN AN ENVIRONMENT OF SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR FOR A BROKEN BAND OF ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS. A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT THIS AFTERNOON. ..THOMPSON/DEAN/GRAMS.. 07/19/2010

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: A GENERALLY ZONAL FLOW PATTERN IS PRESENT TODAY OVER THE NORTHERN THIRD OF THE UNITED STATES...WITH SEVERAL EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGHS PROGRESSING EASTWARD. ONE FEATURE OVER MN/IA HAS RESULTED IN A RATHER LONG-LIVED BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS MOVING ACROSS NORTHERN MO. THESE STORMS APPEAR LIKELY TO PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY AND SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD INTO CENTRAL/SOUTHERN IL. AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AND MODERATE CAPE VALUES...COUPLED WITH 25-35 KNOTS OF WESTERLY MID LEVEL FLOW...WILL SUPPORT A RISK OF MULTICELL STORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL. THESE STORMS MAY ALSO BACKBUILD WESTWARD INTO PARTS OF SOUTHWEST MO LATER THIS AFTERNOON WHERE MUCAPE VALUES OVER 4000 J/KG ARE EXPECTED.

sections.title: NEB/IA/MO
sections.text: OVERNIGHT CONVECTION HAS RESULTED IN A STRONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SURGING SOUTHWARD INTO MO/KS. CLOUDS ALONG AND NORTH OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL SUPPRESS DAYTIME HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...CLOUDS ARE LIKELY TO DIMINISH LATER TODAY WITH DEWPOINTS ACROSS THE REGION CLIMBING WELL INTO THE 70S. THIS WILL LEAD TO A CORRIDOR OF VERY UNSTABLE AIR FROM SOUTHEAST NEB ACROSS SOUTHERN IA/NORTHERN MO. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS SD WILL LIKELY PROVIDE THE FOCUS FOR THUNDERSTORM INTENSIFICATION. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THE RISK OF DISCRETE SUPERCELLS DURING THE FIRST FEW HOURS AFTER INITIATION OVER THIS AREA...WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES POSSIBLE. STORMS MAY CONGEAL INTO A LARGE MCS AND TRACK EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NY/PA INTO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS NY/PA WILL HELP AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM EASTERN PA/NY INTO MA/RI/CT. THIS AREA WAS AFFECTED BY EARLY MORNING STORMS...BUT IS RECOVERING QUICKLY WITH DEWPOINTS NEAR 70F AND TEMPERATURES RISING INTO THE MID 80S. MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE WEAK...BUT THERE IS SUFFICIENT FLOW ALOFT AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR A FEW ORGANIZED MULTICELL STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: MT/WY/SD
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS ID/MT THIS MORNING. THIS FEATURE WILL TRACK INTO EASTERN MT/WY BY THIS EVENING...HELPING TO INITIATE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SOUTHERN MT/NORTHERN WY. THESE STORMS WILL DEVELOP SOUTHEASTWARD DOWN THETA-E AXIS INTO WESTERN SD AND EVENTUALLY INTO NORTHERN NEB. SUPERCELLS AND BOWS WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG THIS CORRIDOR WITH DAMAGING WINDS LIKELY THE MAIN THREAT. ..HART/HURLBUT.. 07/19/2010

sections.title: MID MS INTO OH VLYS
sections.text: CNTRL IL MCS HAS BECOME BETTER DEFINED IN THE PAST HOUR. EARLIER TODAY...SYSTEM MAY HAVE BEEN ENHANCED/SUPPORTED BY A LOW AMPLITUDE UPR IMPULSE NOW ENTERING NRN IL. IN RECENT HOURS THIS FEATURE APPEARS TO HAVE LOST DEFINITION. BUT THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT DOWNSTREAM ACROSS IND/SRN AND CNTRL OH...W/E AXIS OF LWR TROPOSPHERIC CONFLUENCE ALONG ROUGHLY THE I-70 CORRIDOR...AND DEEP WIND PROFILES SUGGEST THAT MCS SHOULD FORWARD-PROPAGATE ESE THROUGH THIS EVE. ADDITIONAL FORWARD-PROPAGATING/BOW SEGMENTS COULD ALSO EVOLVE A BIT LATER THIS AFTN/EVE OVER SRN IL. THE STORMS COULD AFFECT PARTS OF OH...KY...AND PERHAPS WV WITH DMGG WINDS BEFORE THEY WEAKEN LATER TONIGHT. FARTHER UPSTREAM...A SEPARATE AREA OF NEW STORMS COULD DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTN AND EVE IN ZONE OF STRENGTHENING WAA/ASCENT ATOP POST-MCS STORM OUTFLOW OVER NRN MO/WRN IA AND PERHAPS NE KS /REF MCD 1364/.

sections.title: NE CO/SE WY/SW NEB...AND NW KS
sections.text: MESOSCALE AREA OF LOW LVL UPSLOPE FLOW BENEATH PLUME OF ENHANCED MID LVL MOISTURE MAY YET INITIATE SCTD STRONG STORMS IN NERN CO/NW KS. THESE MAY EVOLVE INTO A SMALL CLUSTER...WITH A THREAT FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND/OR SVR HAIL THROUGH LATE TONIGHT.

sections.title: NRN HI PLNS SEWD INTO NEB
sections.text: SETUP STILL REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF SVR STORMS LATER THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY TUE FROM SRN/ERN MT SE ACROSS WRN SD INTO NRN NEB...AS REGION FURTHER DESTABILIZES AHEAD OF DIFFLUENT UPR TROUGH MOVING ESE ACROSS CNTRL MT. SUPERCELLS APPEAR LIKELY...WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...HIGH WINDS...AND ...ESPECIALLY DURING THE EARLY STAGES OF STORM DEVELOPMENT...A TORNADO OR TWO. ..CORFIDI.. 07/19/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1117 AM CDT MON JUL 19 2010/

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS/NRN PLAINS/MID-MS VALLEY
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING IN SWRN SD ASSOCIATED WITH A SUBTLE SHORTWAVE TROUGH EMBEDDED IN WNWLY FLOW ALOFT. A BOWING LINE-SEGMENT IN SW SD WILL MOVE ESEWD ALONG THE NRN EDGE OF STRONG INSTABILITY ACROSS NRN NEB AND MAY REACH FAR WRN IA DURING THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. THE LOW-LEVEL JET IS FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN QUICKLY ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS AND THE ALONG WITH A WEAKER CAP IN THE MID-MS VALLEY MAY ALSO HELP SUSTAIN A DEVELOPING MCS ACROSS NEB TONIGHT. WIND DAMAGE WILL BE LIKELY ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE MCS SO HAVE MAINTAINED A 30 PERCENT WIND PROBABILITY FROM FAR SRN SD ESEWD ACROSS ERN NEB INTO FAR WRN IA. FURTHER TO THE EAST IN THE MID-MS VALLEY...SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ON THE NRN EDGE OF STRONG INSTABILITY IN SE IA AND WRN IL. THE LATEST WSR-88D VWP FROM SPRINGFIELD IL SHOW ABOUT 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR WITH 20 TO 30 KT OF WNWLY FLOW AT 2 KM. THIS COMBINED WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR WIND DAMAGE WITH BOWING LINE-SEGMENTS. LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY WITH CELLS THAT ROTATE.

sections.title: KENTUCKY
sections.text: A LINEAR MCS IS CURRENTLY ONGOING IN CNTRL KY VERY NEAR THE AXIS OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE OH VALLEY. AHEAD OF THE MCS...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS LOCATED ACROSS THE ERN HALF OF KY WITH MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED IN THE 2500 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE. SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S F AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD PROMOTE A ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL WITH THE STRONGER CELLS FOR 1 TO 2 MORE HOURS.

sections.title: SRN NEW ENGLAND/HUDSON RIVER VALLEY
sections.text: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE ONGOING IN SRN NEW ENGLAND NEAR THE AXIS OF A SHORTWAVE-TROUGH. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS MODERATE INSTABILITY IN PLACE ACROSS SRN NEW ENGLAND WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG. IN ADDITION...THE LATEST WSR-88D VWP FROM BOSTON SHOWS ABOUT 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR. THIS COMBINED WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S F WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING WET DOWNBURSTS. THIS THREAT SHOULD LAST ANOTHER HOUR OR SO BEFORE THE STRONGER CELLS MOVE OFFSHORE.

sections.title: SE AZ/SW NM
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING IN ERN AZ ON THE ERN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES IN SRN AZ ESTIMATED FROM 1000 TO 2000 J/KG. THIS COMBINED WITH 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES IN THE 8 TO 9.5 C/KM RANGE SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS. ..BROYLES.. 07/20/2010

mesoscale_discussions.topic: HEAVY RAINFALL VALID 200939Z - 201115Z LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL THREAT WILL PERSIST FOR ROUGHLY ANOTHER TWO HOURS /THROUGH 1130Z/ WITH TRAINING STORMS ALONG MERGING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES IN NE MO AND A SMALL PART OF S CENTRAL IA. A QUASI-STATIONARY NW-SE ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS NE MO IS PROVIDING A FOCUS FOR REPEAT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AS A 45 KT SWLY/WSWLY LLJ TRANSPORTS RICH MOISTURE OVER THE COLD POOL.
